title: Zahlungsabwicklung (Stripe Connect, Checkout, Webhooks, Rückerstattungen, Transaktions-E-Mails)

review_findings.reason: `payment_accounts` allowed an `authenticated` INSERT gated only on `payments.read`, with `stripe_account_id` supplied by the client -- a Manager could point a tenant's payout destination at a Stripe account they control before the real Owner ever connected Stripe.

review_findings.area: webhooks / dedup-retry self-contradiction (#23, shared primitive later reused by #25)
review_findings.reason: The Connect webhook inserted its dedup row before processing, so a genuine mid-processing failure left a claimed-but-unprocessed row that a legitimate Stripe retry of the same event id could never reprocess (a plain unique-violation was always read as already-handled).
A delayed/out-of-order account.updated event could clobber newer, already-known account status.
Several smaller findings across the remaining tickets, resolved alongside the two HIGH findings in the same repair pass.

required_actions: Remove the client-writable payment_accounts INSERT path; create the row only via service-role code immediately after the Stripe Express account is created server-side.
Make the webhook dedup claim reclaimable so a genuine retry of an unprocessed event can succeed.
Add an event-timestamp ordering guard against out-of-order account.updated events.
Resolve the remaining medium/low findings across #24/#25/#26/#40.

review_findings.reason: An 'unconfirmed' refund (ambiguous Stripe failure, e.g. network timeout -- Stripe may or may not have actually processed it) only blocked further refund attempts against the same payment via the aggregate amount-headroom check, not via its own existence. A second, smaller refund attempt could still reach Stripe with a fresh idempotency key while the first attempt's real outcome was unknown -- a genuine double-refund risk.
claim_payment_webhook_event() had only mock-level test coverage in the two webhook route test files, never exercised against a live database.
apply_connect_account_snapshot() overwrote onboarding_completed_at on every 'enabled' snapshot and nulled it on any later non-'enabled' status, losing the original completion time.
isDefinitiveStripeFailure() miscategorized a 429 StripeRateLimitError as ambiguous rather than definitive.

required_actions: Reject any further refunds INSERT for a payment while an 'unconfirmed' row exists, at both the DB trigger and application layer, with a dedicated typed error and translated message.
Add a live-database integration test for claim_payment_webhook_event().
Fix onboarding_completed_at to be preserved via coalesce across snapshots.
Classify StripeRateLimitError as a definitive Stripe failure.
cycles.resolved_by: Fixes applied on feat/23 and feat/26 (lowest branches owning each fix), merged forward sequentially through feat/24 -> feat/25 -> feat/26 -> feat/40, each merge point re-verified CI-green. Two smaller residual findings (no explicit mutual-exclusion lock for claim_payment_webhook_event(), currently harmless due to idempotent downstream operations; possible orphaned Stripe Express account on a DB-insert failure after account creation) were deliberately not fixed in-place and are tracked as issues #91 and #92 instead, recorded in docs/decisions/assumptions.md.

review_findings.area: payments / RLS -- refund finalization is client-reachable
review_findings.reason: `grant update on refunds to authenticated` + refunds_update_payments_refund let a payments.refund holder finalize rows via PostgREST directly. A row still 'pending' because its finalize UPDATE was lost can be flipped to 'failed' from a raw client call, releasing its reservation.
review_findings.required_correction: Move finalization into a service_role SECURITY DEFINER RPC (finalize_refund(id, status, stripe_refund_id)) and drop the authenticated UPDATE grant/policy.
review_findings.outcome: not fixed in this cycle -- filed as issue #93, does not block merge

review_findings.area: payments -- unchecked finalize writes / no exit from terminal 'unconfirmed'
review_findings.reason: Both finalize updates in issueRefundForOrder ignore the returned error. A lost update leaves a permanently 'pending' row reserving the amount with no reconciliation path; symmetrically, 'unconfirmed' is terminal and unreachable for app-facing roles, so one unconfirmed refund permanently blocks all further refunds for that payment until direct DB access intervenes -- no runbook documents this.
review_findings.required_correction: Check/log the update errors, and document (or build) the reconciliation procedure for 'unconfirmed'/stuck-'pending' refunds in docs/operations.
review_findings.outcome: not fixed in this cycle -- filed as issue #94, does not block merge

review_findings.reason: startStripeOnboardingAction (creates the Express account and every subsequent Account Link, i.e. controls the payout destination) is gated on the read-shaped payments.read, held by Manager. Consistent with the documented threat model, but the sensitivity warrants its own permission before production activation.
review_findings.required_correction: Introduce an Owner-only payments.connect permission for onboarding/account-link creation before real payouts are enabled.
review_findings.outcome: not fixed in this cycle -- filed as issue #95, must resolve before production Stripe activation

review_findings.reason: checkoutAction's catch returns raw error.message to the guest, now including internal payment-layer/Stripe SDK messages, contrary to the repo's error-shape rule.
review_findings.required_correction: Map known domain errors to translated messages and return a generic message for everything else.
review_findings.outcome: not fixed in this cycle -- filed as issue #96

review_findings.reason: Two rapid submissions of a partial refund create two independent, individually-within-headroom refunds (client-side disabling only). Bounded by the paid amount, so not an over-refund, but a double-partial-refund by double-click is possible.
review_findings.required_correction: Optional: carry a client-generated request token and reject a repeat within a short window.
review_findings.outcome: not fixed in this cycle -- filed as issue #97, optional polish

residual_risks: markOrderReceived() is not transactional -- crash between the received transition and the payments update leaves payment 'pending' and the order non-refundable via the UI (tracked: #90).

No awaiting_payment timeout sweep (#88); Sentry not wired (#89); claim_payment_webhook_event() concurrency relies on downstream idempotency, not an explicit lock (#91); orphaned Stripe Express account possible on insert failure (#92).
Integration/RLS tests could not be executed locally (no Docker/Postgres available on this dev machine); evidence is the CI Migration Check run at the exact head sha of each merged branch.
